title: Build an Evidence-Backed Execution Plan
service: EvidPlan: resumable evidence-backed plan and proof obligations

planted_bugs: plan_document schedules invalid plans and exposes an internal ValueError
unknown dependencies skip independent cycle findings
annotated irreversible resolver ordering is unchecked
cycle_members independently searches from every vertex for a return path; blocked downstream tails are traversed repeatedly, O(V*(V+E))
parts.timing_assert: cycle_members on a two-node cycle with 4000 blocked downstream items under 0.1 seconds; the original 10000-item waves chain under 0.14 seconds remains a healthy-helper guard

timing_measured.graph: two-node prerequisite cycle with 4000 downstream tail items

parts.overfix_guard: preserve cycle edges, exact waves and repeated-dependency semantics; retain all members of every disjoint cycle and explicit self-loop, exclude downstream tails, unknown-only and isolated vertices, and do not mutate the plan

parts.lesson_anchor: Design for Interruption: store the plan next to the work

parts.lesson_anchor: Exercise 3 split an item with two proof commands; Plan Validation irreversible ordering
traps: all downstream and resolver refs expanded in order
prerequisite ancestor checks rather than path dominance

deviations: A correct iterative SCC partition helper _components and latest journal scanning are provided. Part 1 cycle_members is candidate code: its initially correct per-vertex return-path searches are too slow on blocked tails, so the candidate consumes one SCC partition rather than implementing SCC from scratch. Kahn wave scheduling is already healthy; its original long-chain assertions and wrong fixes remain as helper guards.

Irreversible resolver ids and approval events are explicit exercise annotations supplied by a human; mechanical dependency checks do not infer real-world risk resolution or authorization. Resolver prerequisite inclusion is used rather than the planning suggestion of graph path domination.

Part 4 renders interleaved fake worker receipts and supports cancellation/resumption of the view; it does not add another concurrent job scheduler. This directly exercises the lesson JSON-source Markdown view and interruption requirements.
The journal Event schema, exact proof freshness across prerequisite artifacts, split id syntax and checklist line codes are deterministic exercise contracts; no external protocol is claimed.

Complete-content comparison is supplied correctly in stream._changes, preserving all duplicate-output guards and mutations. The candidate implements session continuation, per-event multi-row emission, ordering and cancellation; it does not repeat the chapter 38/40 primary content-deduplication exercise.

JSONL records use physical LF framing; Unicode separators inside Event summaries are raw text. This round-trip boundary and restore-splitlines mutation are secondary guards, not a new candidate primary trap.
